caption: She wanted bahar. He wanted bistar. So they negotiated like every married couple with one outdoor person and one low-battery person. Bas neeche tak also counts.
alt_text: A desi couple negotiates going out versus staying in at home.
He is sleepy in bed while she wants to step outside.
They settle for going only downstairs together.
posting_notes: Keep caption raw and daily. Do not add a moral like 'love is compromise.'
